objective: Define verification model for frontend financial display hooks to ensure correct data fetching, validation, and state management
overview: This document defines the verification model for the frontend financial display layer (M46.15). The model ensures that all financial display hooks correctly fetch data from backend APIs with proper error handling, render financial entities with validated data shapes, maintain consistent state transitions, and provide accessible and responsive UIs.

required_behaviors: Display key metrics (net worth, liabilities, assets)

test_coverage_matrix.test_scenarios: Initial load, create account, update account, delete account, error handling
Initial load, card CRUD, error handling
Initial load, create loan, update loan, schedule preview, error handling
Initial load, investment CRUD, portfolio calculation

success_criteria: All hooks return consistent HookState<T> with correct data, loading, error, isFetching, hasLoaded
Data parsing matches Zod schemas (no type mismatches)
Loading states appear during API calls
State transitions (load -> success/error -> recovered) work correctly
Edge cases (empty data, null values, malformed responses) are handled gracefully
implementation_notes: Use @tanstack/react-query for data fetching and caching
Leverage zod for runtime schema validation
Follow existing hook patterns (useQuery, useMutation, useAsyncQuery)
Ensure all hooks are exported for consumption
Add unit tests for each hook covering happy path and error scenarios
